verdict.rule: Pass when (1) the final method has a lower MAE and a lower RMSE than every baseline at cell-month level, and (2) on regional monthly totals it is not distinguishably worse than the best baseline: the 90% paired bootstrap interval of the difference in absolute error is not entirely above zero. If it fails, the best baseline ships and the result is stated. Scored on coverage-adequate months.
